task_message:
Case M13: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 480x480x294 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M13 is complete. Final summary:

- **Target identified:** a multilobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense soft-tissue mass in the subcutaneous/perifascial fat of the lateral hip/gluteal region (fat-suppressed T2), consistent with a myxoid soft-tissue tumor.
- **Workflow:** located it on axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets, seeded it with a point on the largest lobule (v1, 140 mL), added the adjacent bright nodule missed by the first pass (v2, 228 mL), and added the small posterior satellite lobule (v3, 243 mL, single connected component).
- **Verification:** judged the intensity-based candidate proposals (C1–C3) as surrounding fat/normal tissue and rejected them; reviewed five slices per plane at both ends of the mask — no lesion tissue beyond the mask ends, outline follows the hyperintense mass in all three planes, no stray components.
- **Confidence:** medium (fringe of small hyperintense nodules posterior to the mass and the faint inferior/fascial extension are borderline).
